name: ab_created_at_index_trap
description: The tempting index: orders(created_at) speeds up the recent-orders feed but the planner then walks it for 'latest orders of customer X'. The guardrail sample includes the 10 heaviest customers, where the plan flips (F-9).

queries.name: recent_orders_feed
queries.sql: SELECT id, customer_id, amount FROM orders WHERE created_at > %s ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50

queries.name: latest_orders_for_customer
queries.sql: SELECT id, amount, created_at FROM orders WHERE customer_id = %s ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10

queries.name: touch_order
queries.sql: UPDATE orders SET updated_at = updated_at + interval '1 second' WHERE id = %s
